title: GAO reports financial and operational benefits for fiscal year 2025
text:
The U.S. Government Accountability Office released its fiscal year 2025 performance report. The agency calculated that its work produced $62.7 billion in financial benefits for the federal government and 1,295 other improvements across programs involving public safety, national security, and health care. The release describes these figures as the result of audits, evaluations, and recommendations supplied to Congress.

The report also summarizes GAO's role in congressional oversight and federal performance. It presents the agency's output and estimated savings without endorsing either major party, criticizing an administration, or advocating a partisan policy program. Its tone is institutional and descriptive, and the quoted official discusses accountability to Congress and the public rather than electoral politics.
